config.name: Resource Health — Read First
config.description: Read first guide for this dashboard.
config.content:
Resource Health
Operational view of where risk is concentrated across resources, collectors, and websites.
Questions this dashboard answers
  • Where are alerts concentrated geographically or by type?
  • Which resources are dead or minimally monitored?
  • Are collectors healthy enough to trust the data?
  • Are websites failing?
Recommended review flow
  1. Map + NOC — Find concentration
  2. Dead / minimal KPIs — Blind spots
  3. Collector alerts — Data pipeline
  4. Website dead count — Service checks
Where to go next
  • Active alert triage → 03
  • Collector diagnostics → 07
  • Website detail → 05
  • Coverage / discovery → 04
  • Technical investigation → 30
Tip: Empty or zero values may mean healthy state or missing tokens/LogicModules — confirm before concluding.
